high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "jacobandco." The post features a close-up of a person's wrist wearing an exquisite, highly ornate watch. The watch is encrusted with numerous pink rubies, creating a striking and luxurious appearance. The watch face is rectangular and showcases intricate mechanical details, including gears and hands, which are visible through the transparent crystal cover. The person wearing the watch is dressed in formal attire, as indicated by the maroon velvet sleeve and white shirt cuff.
